title: NiceAssOS L3 Organ Manifest
description: ◊·κ=φ⁴ · declarative manifest a tool ships at repo root as organ.json to declare itself as an L3 organ of NiceAssOS · niceassos-spec §2 L3 · every organ = an existing estate tool bound to a ring (R0-R6) that publishes fork_join on load and beacon every 60s.

name.description: Repo slug of the tool · lowercase kebab-case · matches sjgant80-hub/<name>

ring.description: Ring position · 0 ground · 1 perception · 2 gate · 3 heart · 4 naming · 5 observation · 6 resolution

glyph.description: Single-char ring glyph · ▓ ◉ ▲ ♡ ◈ ◯ ◊ · or organ-specific override

publishes.description: Envelope kinds this organ emits on niceassos-mesh

listens.description: Envelope kinds or event names this organ subscribes to · common: cassie:tick, bloom_pulse, beacon

konomi_pub_source.description: Where to load the fork public key from · 'identity.pub' (default · IndexedDB niceassos-seed-v1) · 'fresh' (mint new) · '<hex>' (hardcoded)

spec_version.description: niceassos-spec version this organ targets · e.g. niceassos-spec/0.2

legacy_channel.description: Legacy BroadcastChannel for si-didy estate compat

beacon_interval_ms.description: How often to emit a beacon · default 60s

grafted_at.description: When this organ was grafted into the L3 mesh
